features.name: Interactive terminal with streaming and interruption
features.acceptance_criterion: Stream a tool-backed terminal conversation and interrupt then redirect the active task without starting an unrelated session.

tests: terminal streams live text/progress, interrupts a tool, and redirects the same persisted session
typing a revision cancels an active model and /exit cleans up signal handlers
readline Ctrl+C keeps the terminal open for a same-session revision
progress excludes raw tool results and provider errors; EOF settles work
OpenAI SSE delivers genuine text before completion and assembles fragmented tool calls/usage
Anthropic SSE streams text blocks and assembles tool input with final usage
cancelling a real SSE response leaves partial text uncommitted and usage attempt incomplete
parameterized_tests: openai / anthropic accepts CR-only SSE delimiters with the final CR at EOF
openai / anthropic preserves received usage and observed output after token limit / cancellation before end marker
evidence.detail: CLI chat runs an interactive terminal conversation. Actual provider SSE text deltas arrive before completion; model/tool/run progress reflects persisted activity. Ctrl+C, /cancel or typed revision aborts the active model/tool, waits for cleanup, and runs the revision with the same persisted sessionId; only /new requests a new session. Focused fixtures verify interrupted-tool reconciliation and same-session message history, genuine pre-completion deltas, fragmented UTF-8/tool JSON/usage assembly, CR-only EOF framing, and retained observed usage on failed or cancelled streams. Partial text remains uncommitted and is not reported as a final answer.
evidence.validation_source: Auditor inspected current committed source and fixtures at 0822722. Parent reports 19 focused tests passed and specification/quality review approved these deltas. No tests rerun by this auditor.
evidence.supported_acceptance_scope: Interactive terminal with local deterministic and loopback provider fixtures. Configured hosted provider performance and compatibility beyond the tested protocol subset remain unverified.

features.acceptance_criterion: Read, edit and verify a workspace file and execute a scoped shell command with captured exit status.

tests: demo writes, reads, verifies, and persists a multi-step session
opt-in shell executes real workspace project commands with literal argument arrays
a tool-backed runtime run persists actual host execution evidence
shell environment excludes model/vault keys and rejects unselected env configuration
shell rejects denied aliases, permissions, traversal, and linked cwd

evidence.detail: Workspace file tools read/write/verify actual contents. Opt-in shell.execute runs an explicitly configured absolute native-executable alias with literal argument arrays, a checked workspace cwd, selected non-secret environment keys and a separate permission. It returns captured stdout/stderr, actual exit code/signal, duration, target identity and cleanup status. Fixtures create and verify real output files, capture nonzero exits, reject unconfigured aliases/paths/permissions, bound combined decoded UTF-8 output, enforce timeouts and exercise cancellation/shutdown.
evidence.validation_source: Auditor ran node --test tests/history.test.mjs tests/shell.test.mjs against the rebuilt current tree: all 16 tests passed, including all 11 shell tests and decoded-output correction 637a518. File read/write/verify fixture was previously inspected; parent reports current full npm suite 91 passed / 1 skipped and Python 16 passed.
evidence.supported_acceptance_scope: Trusted host execution scoped by configured alias, startup cwd, explicit permission and environment selection. Configurable timeout is at most 120 seconds; combined returned stdout/stderr at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes; one active command per integration. This is not OS/filesystem/network isolation: authorized programs can access host paths or launch other programs. Escaped descendants or children after parent exit may survive, and incomplete cleanup is reported. No container, OS-sandbox, remote-execution or universal resource-isolation entry is upgraded.
